# catalystcenter_deploy_template (Resource)

This resource can manage a Deploy Template.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "catalystcenter_deploy_template" "example" {
  template_id         = "12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789012"
  deployment_timeout  = 300
  force_push_template = false
  copying_config      = true
  is_composite        = false
  target_info = [
    {
      host_name             = "SW01"
      type                  = "MANAGED_DEVICE_HOSTNAME"
      versioned_template_id = "12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789012"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Secret template parameters

Terraform 1.11 or later supports `secret_params` on this resource. Keep ordinary
parameters in `target_info[].params`. Supply secrets using the separate list so
their values are omitted from saved Terraform plans and state:

```terraform
variable "template_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

resource "catalystcenter_deploy_template" "secret_example" {
  template_id = "12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789012"
  redeploy    = "ON_CHANGE"

  target_info = [{
    id   = "87654321-4321-4321-4321-210987654321"
    type = "MANAGED_DEVICE_UUID"
    params = {
      description = ["Branch switch"]
    }
  }]

  secret_params = [{
    target_id = "87654321-4321-4321-4321-210987654321"
    params_wo = {
      password = [var.template_password]
    }
    params_wo_versions = {
      password = 1
    }
  }]
}
```

For a composite member, set `member_template_id` to the matching
`member_template_deployment_info[].template_id`.

Increment the matching `params_wo_versions` value when rotating a secret.
Version changes respect `ON_CHANGE`, `ALWAYS`, and `NEVER`; changing only a
write-only value does not produce a Terraform diff.

Supply all current secrets whenever a target is redeployed, including after a
public parameter changes; their values cannot be recovered from state.
Removing a secret does not erase a device password. Migration does not remove
formerly public values from older state backups.

See [Managing Secrets](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/CiscoDevNet/catalystcenter/latest/docs/guides/secrets)
for ephemeral inputs, credential resources, and migration from state-backed secrets.

## Schema

### Required

- `target_info` (Attributes Set) Target info to deploy template (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--target_info))
- `template_id` (String) ID of template to be provisioned

### Optional

- `copying_config` (Boolean) Copy config from running into startup
- `deployment_id` (String) In-flight DNAC deployment id, set when an apply times out before SUCCESS/FAILURE. Cleared by Read on SUCCESS.
- `deployment_timeout` (Number) Maximum time in seconds to wait for the template deployment to reach `SUCCESS` or `FAILURE`. If it is still running when the timeout expires, a warning is reported and the deployment is reconciled on the next apply. Changing this value alone does not trigger a redeployment. Defaults to `300`.
  - Range: `10`-`86400`
  - Default value: `300`
- `force_push_template` (Boolean) Force Push Template
- `is_composite` (Boolean) Composite template flag
- `main_template_id` (String) Composite Template ID
- `member_template_deployment_info` (Attributes List) Member Template Deployment Info (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--member_template_deployment_info))
- `redeploy` (String) Attribute that controls when the template should be redeployed. `ALWAYS` redeploys it on every Terraform apply, `ON_CHANGE` redeploys only when the template’s content changes, and `NEVER` prevents redeployment.
  - Choices: `ALWAYS`, `ON_CHANGE`, `NEVER`
- `secret_params` (Attributes List) Secret parameters for existing deployment targets. Terraform >= 1.11 is required. Secret values must be supplied whenever a target is redeployed; only target references and rotation versions are stored in state. Entries are matched by target and member identity, not list position. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--secret_params))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

- `host_name` (String) Hostname of device is required if targetType is MANAGED_DEVICE_HOSTNAME

  - Choices: `ALWAYS`, `ON_CHANGE`, `NEVER`
- `resource_params` (Attributes List) Resource params to be provisioned (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--target_info--resource_params))
- `versioned_template_id` (String) Versioned template ID to be provisioned

<a id="nestedatt--secret_params"></a>
### Nested Schema for `secret_params`

Optional:

- `member_template_id` (String) Composite member template_id containing the target. Omit for a regular or top-level target.
- `params_wo` (Map of List of String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only secret parameter values as lists of strings. Values are omitted from Terraform plan and state. Names must not also exist in the target's public params. Every key requires a matching params_wo_versions key. All secrets are resent whenever the target is deployed.
- `params_wo_versions` (Map of Number) Positive integer rotation versions keyed by secret parameter name. Every known secret entry must supply this map with matching keys. Change a version whenever its secret changes. Versions remain in state and are never sent to CatC. Version changes respect the target's redeploy policy.
- `target_host_name` (String) Hostname matching an existing target_info.host_name. Exactly one of target_id and target_host_name must be set.
- `target_id` (String) Target ID matching an existing target_info.id. Exactly one of target_id and target_host_name must be set.
